reproducibility.typed_plan_contents: operations, ids, arguments, references, comments and output contracts

previous_raw_rescored.note: The archived typed-DAG responses were scored directly with the corrected scorer. This is a historical baseline, not a controlled prompt-only comparison.

contract_corrections: Initial inputs are literal input_1, input_2, ... placeholders; only earlier step outputs use $step_id.
Only operations with executable plan bindings are offered.
Output kind and cardinality are checked against operation guarantees and the overall DAG result, including intermediate deliverables.
run_sql declares every input through input_paths, making SQL references part of the typed DAG and its provenance.
service_area accepts start_points_path and computes reachability from every origin.
Defensible alternative methods are accepted instead of forcing one sequence.
DDL, saved-view rewrites and live virtual views are refused separately from the 63 supported cases.
comparison_limit: Many prompt, scorer, truth and capability corrections were measured across iterations. The final pair uses one frozen prompt, catalogue, dataset and scorer. The earlier 38/65 baseline is historical and not a controlled before/after estimate.
